items.title: The Joy of Painting (Almost HD Collection)
items.description: Collected over the years are all rips/copies of "The Joy of Painting" featuring Bob Ross in the best quality available to me. These are from a ton of different sources, and there are a few episodes that just aren't available in better than 360-480p quality. These are all a great base to begin a rema
